page.layout: One column of running text; at its foot, left, the signature "G 5" and, at the right, the catchword "EXER-". No marginal notes. Running head at the top.

main_text.l: caufis.Morborum totius substantiae (inqt)
alij quidem manifesti sunt, alij occulti. Ma-
nifesti ut scabies, phthisis, horumque simi-
les. Et libro de Externis affectibus, cap.5.
ipsam scabiem esse affectum ex intemperie
calida, dissolutione continui, compositum
his verbis indicat. Scabies alpredo cutis
est, seu leuis exulceratio pruriens, aut in-
terdum rodens. Fit aut ex humidiore qua-
vis pustula, sive pallida, sive livida, sive ni-
gra fit: quae rupta ulcusculum in cute pro-
fert humidum, aut etiam interdum expur-
gata sanie aridum, idq; modo cum pruri-
gine sola, modo cum leui rubore in ambi-
tu, cumq; calore, ac dolore. Ex reficcata sa-
nie crustula obdurescit, qua saepe ulcuscu-
lum obducitur. Haec Fernelius, quibus sibi
dissentire satis arguit. Nam morbus, quem
totius substantiae statuit, & continui disso-
lutio-plurimum inter se discrepant: quan-
doquidem ille partis similaris dutaxat est
vitium. Haec vero tum similarium, tum dis-
similarium partium communis morbus, quem
admodum aperte docet ipse Fernelius, ca-
pite nono lib. de Morborum differen-
tiis, ubi de communi morbo
expresse tractat.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "cutis" after "alpredo" (partly obscured by a stain/mark on the scan) and the word after "quauis" are read from the scan with some uncertainty. Printing irregularities kept as printed: "diffentire" for dissentire is normalised to "dissentire" by the long-s rule; "dissolutio-plurimum" has a dash where a full stop/semicolon may be intended. The "»" marks at line ends are printed ornaments, not text. The "Ma-nifesti" break appears without a printed hyphen and is written whole.
